title: KTP Risk Factors
description: The six weighted Risk Factor inputs to the risk aggregate R for the Kinetic Trust Protocol. The Soul veto is evaluated before aggregation and is not a term in it (see soul-constraint.json); six-plus-veto, not seven.

evidence_density.description: Weight and density of presence in the environment: human presence, spatial and electromagnetic congestion, telemetry volume. High density slows operations and raises the cost of movement.

trust_trend.description: Rate of change of standing, and its direction: how fast trust-relevant state is moving. Captures acceleration up or down so decisions are not made against a stale level.

adversarial_pressure.description: Measured adversarial stress on the environment: attack indicators, anomaly rates, active-incident signals. This measures stress, not energy transfer.

moment_criticality.description: Criticality of the current moment or operational phase: maintenance windows, cutovers, deadline proximity, ceremonial or protected periods.

update_resistance.description: How hard the trust value is to move: the depth of the evidence base behind current standing. Standing backed by deep evidence shifts slowly.

attestation_coverage.description: How much of the agent's activity is witnessed and attestable: oversight population, audit reach, fraction of actions under observation.
